title: Intake Triage Scorer
dek: Intakegate is a triage pipeline I built for messages to a children's therapy service: it reads each message and proposes how soon a person should review it. This page runs its priority scorer, rule for rule: two safety gates, then a points total, tested over every combination of what it reads.
summary: Which signals can move an intake message's priority? Every combination scored: urgent wording moves none, and the safety gates override the rest.
